reasons: Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.65% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +2bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.5pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 14bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 151 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 83 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 14.3 sits at the 3th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 8.2, so implied carries +6.1 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: SoftBank prices record ¥1 trillion ($6.3B) retail bond at high end of range to fund OpenAI stake
items.note: Japan's biggest-ever retail bond priced at 4.75%, the top of the 4.3-4.9% guided range, with proceeds earmarked to refinance part of the $40B bridge loan backing SoftBank's OpenAI investment -- pricing at the high end signals investors are demanding a bigger premium for this debt-on-debt AI financing chain.

items.headline: Blackstone's flagship $77B private credit fund gates redemptions again as withdrawal requests double the cap
items.note: BCRED received ~$4.3B (10% of shares) in Q3 repurchase requests but will only honor the standard 5% quarterly limit, showing sustained investor demand to exit private credit even as the sector's default rate sits at a five-year high with AI-exposed borrowers a growing share of the stress.

items.headline: Oracle falls 4-5%, Nebius slips as bond-market selloff raises cost of debt-funded AI buildouts
items.note: 10-year Treasury yields hit a one-year high (~4.78%) in a broader bond selloff, hitting Oracle ($122B in long-term debt, $43B raised in FY26) and fellow debt-funded neocloud Nebius hardest -- a macro rate move rather than an issuer-specific credit event, but it directly raises refinancing costs for the most leveraged AI builders.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
